players.product: CMP polishing pads (hard and soft pads), CMP slurries and post-CMP cleaning solutions; immersion ArF and KrF wafer photoresists (8 grades on volume orders, 300-ton Qianjiang line ramping)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record; chairman Zhu Shuangquan): Jan-Sep 2026 revenue about RMB 29.15 hundred million, up 8% year over year, with Q3 revenue about RMB 9.90 hundred million, up 9% quarter over quarter; Jan-Sep net profit attributable expected at about RMB 8.4-8.6 hundred million, up 62%-66%, with Q3 about RMB 3.1-3.3 hundred million, up 49%-59% year over year and 12%-19% quarter over quarter; excluding the profit of the printing-consumables terminal business deconsolidated after an equity transfer, Jan-Sep net profit attributable rose about 73%. Semiconductor materials (CMP pads, CMP slurries and cleaning solutions, high-end wafer photoresists) grew quickly; lithium-battery functional auxiliary materials grew since consolidation; semiconductor display materials were under short-term pressure from customer utilization.
quarterly_data.figure: Jan-Sep 2026 revenue ~RMB 29.15 hundred million (+8%); Jan-Sep net profit attributable ~RMB 8.4-8.6 hundred million (+62%-66%); Q3 net profit ~RMB 3.1-3.3 hundred million (+49%-59% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): Jan-Sep 2026 CMP polishing-pad sales revenue was about RMB 11.36 hundred million, up 43%, and September shipments hit a monthly record; the company calls itself the leading domestic supplier of IC CMP pads, deeply tied to leading domestic wafer fabs, and has entered and won orders in large silicon wafers, third-generation SiC and advanced-packaging TSV, with products shipping. Hard- and soft-pad scale-up projects are proceeding on plan. Lithium-battery functional auxiliary materials have reached small-batch shipments to overseas customers, and CMP materials, high-end wafer photoresists and display materials are in overseas validation and introduction.
quarterly_data.figure: Jan-Sep 2026 polishing-pad revenue ~RMB 11.36 hundred million (+43%); record monthly shipments in September
